title: Application getting AMQ8135 Not authorized when trying to PUT messages to queue
description: The new order processing service started this week is getting AMQ8135 Not authorized when attempting to put messages to the ORDER.PROCESSING.Q queue. The service account has been set up in AD but MQ access has not been configured.

worklogs.description: Verified service account 'svc-orderproc' does not have any MQ authority records set.
Granted PUT authority on ORDER.PROCESSING.Q and CONNECT authority on the queue manager.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, the service account svc-orderproc has not been granted MQ authority. I need to grant it PUT authority on the ORDER.PROCESSING.Q queue and CONNECT authority to the queue manager. I will also grant INQQ (inquire) access which is typically needed by applications. Before I apply these, could you confirm whether the service also needs to GET messages from any queue, or only PUT?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: It only PUTs messages to ORDER.PROCESSING.Q. It does not read from any queue.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Perfect, minimal permissions applied. CONNECT and INQQ on the queue manager, and PUT + INQQ on ORDER.PROCESSING.Q only. Please test your service.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Service is now putting messages successfully. The order processing pipeline is running. Thank you.

resolutionNote: Service account svc-orderproc had no MQ authority records. Granted CONNECT and INQQ on queue manager, PUT and INQQ on ORDER.PROCESSING.Q.
